meta.title: Withdraw an event that is live with no bids without a reason

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with no bids on the buyer side.
Attempt to withdraw the project while leaving the withdrawal reason empty.

args.text: Please enter reason for withdrawing this event

steps.note: Verify Procol refuses the withdrawal with the required-reason message.
Verify the project remains unchanged and the withdrawal action is still available.
